title: Newsletter issue
description: Prepare one issue of a customer or prospect newsletter: subject, content, the list it goes to and its consent, and how it is measured.

inputs.label: Mailing list or segment and the legal basis for contacting it
Releases, articles or events this issue covers

tool_actions.description: Sending the issue through the email tool.
Publishing the web version of the issue.

sections.title: Subject and preview text
sections.prompt: The subject line and preview text, and the one thing the reader should take away.

sections.title: Content blocks
sections.prompt: Each block with its headline, two or three sentences and one link.

sections.title: Audience and consent
sections.prompt: The list or segment, its legal basis, the sender identity and the unsubscribe link.

sections.title: Measurement
sections.prompt: Tagged links, the metric that matters for this issue and the previous issue's result.

checks.verification: The list and its legal basis are confirmed by the data protection owner.
A test send shows the sender, the required legal mentions and a working unsubscribe link.
Every link opens and carries the campaign parameters agreed for the issue.
